name: DBXen burnBatch ERC-2771 sender split
summary: Called through its trusted ERC-2771 forwarder, DBXen.burnBatch credits accCycleBatchesBurned to _msgSender() but burns XEN from msg.sender, so the XEN onTokenBurned callback sets lastActiveCycle for the forwarder instead of the user. The user's burned batches then stay unsettled against a stale cycle, and claimFees pays that user a share of the accrued protocol fees computed from cycle-0 rewards. The attacker drained the fee pool on Ethereum and, 75 minutes later, the BNB Chain deployment.

loss.notes: Native fee-pool payouts minus the protocol fees the exploit transactions paid in. DXN minted to the attackers by claimRewards is supply inflation, not depleted victim assets, and is excluded.

ageReset.description: Ownerless immutable runtime; the trusted forwarder and XEN address are constructor arguments.

sources.note: Loss. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer), summing native value into and out of each DBXen deployment: source-1 sends 0.0920084803085568 ETH into Ethereum DBXen and receives 0.014590720794283264 ETH change plus a claimFees (0xd294f093) payout of 65.361960326939766177 ETH to 0x425d3ec2dcebe2c04ba1687504d43afc6be7328d; net 65.28454256742549264 ETH. On BNB Chain DBXen 0x9caf6c4e5b9e3a6f83182befd782304c7a8ee6de, 0xe66e54586827d6a9e1c75bd1ea42fa60891ad341909d29ec896253ee2365d366 (block 86063902) nets 22.627867313166268137 BNB and 0x84098dbcc5b5f205ed816cd62bc3d68fb833a75d9760aafc61af4e59b330da3e (block 86075073, timestamp 1773280004, a copycat) nets 0.590563300702988245 BNB. The only other forwarder burn, 0x8cf27070bcd28d79b58d732e37b1b899553a9bd006be83d517590a68134bf786, reverts its claim for insufficient balance and gains nothing. Etherscan internal transactions from both deployments to block 24700000 / 86300000 contain no further payout above 0.031 ETH or 0.003 BNB.

Root cause, anchor and age. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 24637401, index 108): attacker contract 0xeb233deaeb7f594e2a73e914ee1f6ae79b491866 calls forwarder 0xf3281221ba95af0c5bbcbd2474ce8c090233133b, which calls DBXen burnBatch (0x937c5414); DBXen calls XEN burn (0x9dc29fac) and XEN calls back onTokenBurned (0x543746b1) with the forwarder as user; the forwarder then relays claimFees and claimRewards (0x372500ab, minting DXN). Verified source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, DBXen, v0.8.17; SHA-256 of SourceCode 8bdc7a238c987ed653145af30d714f81916aacb4452d7ed64121ae0e132c670a): gasWrapper adds to accCycleBatchesBurned[_msgSender()], burnBatch calls xen.burn(msg.sender, ...), onTokenBurned sets lastActiveCycle[user], and updateStats settles an account only when currentCycle > lastActiveCycle[account]. Earliest exercise: the split needs a Burn(address,uint256) event whose user is the forwarder; eth_getLogs on DBXen for that topic with topic1 = the forwarder, blocks 16883586..24640000, returns only source-1 (36714 Burn events in total). Age: eth_getCode is empty at block 16883585 and keccak256 of the runtime is the recorded hash at blocks 16883586 and 24637400; source-2 is a top-level creation by 0x5a5d0ad85762979caae341274f0eba22df8ecedd at index 289. The contract has no owner or setter; forwarder and XEN address are constructor arguments. The BNB Chain deployment (runtime hash 0x23c2ab2238871442502783314f5c61836193d2ab32a84d78955cd9d2c8afc4cb, created by the same deployer in 0x49bbfd0da01298014bff1797b8764b7f300c8deaa6101b5e5d3ca07fa9df9aa6) has no forwarder burn before 0xe66e5458, 75 minutes after source-1, and is merged as loss only.
